title: SR x EBM Happy SearchHen
description:
Use it online (always the latest version): https://sunfloraf-sketch.github.io/sr-ebm-happy-searchhen/

A set of four browser-based tools for systematic-review literature searching: a Proximity Builder that assembles adjacency/near fragments from synonym stacks, a PICO Strategy Builder that generates line-numbered strategies with controlled-vocabulary (MeSH / Emtree / CINAHL Headings) mapping, a Search Syntax Converter that translates a query across seven databases/platforms (MEDLINE (Ovid), PubMed, Cochrane, Embase, CINAHL, Web of Science, Scopus), and PubMed Light, which builds PubMed searches row by row (PICO + study design) with MeSH suggestions, one-click synonyms (Entry Terms), MeSH hierarchy and See Also browsing, custom combinations and live PubMed counts. All tools run in the browser; no research data is uploaded. Only MeSH lookups and PubMed result counts are sent to the official NLM MeSH services and NCBI E-utilities API.

PubMed and MeSH data are provided by the U.S. National Library of Medicine (NLM) and the National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI). This toolkit is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by NLM, NCBI, or NIH.
